author: Abhijit Khuperkar
title: Oracle AI Data Platform: Financial Investigation Copilot
title_alternatives: From Data Foundation to Financial Investigation | Oracle AIDP
Evidence-Led Financial Investigation with Oracle AI Data Platform
Oracle AIDP Demo: Medallion Data, Analytics and an Investigation Copilot
description:
Which accounts should an analyst investigate first, what evidence supports the priority, and which policy applies?

Follow a financial-investigation workflow for fictional Meridian Demo Bank: Spark Bronze, Silver and Gold; a separate random-forest training workflow; verified initial Gold publication through AI Lakehouse; notebook and Oracle Analytics reporting; Agent Builder; testing and deployment; Agent Hub; and a Streamlit analyst workspace.

The copilot uses seven predefined, parameterized SQL tools and eight fictional policy/definition documents to support evidence-backed review. The existing agent tools use a dedicated snapshot; Oracle Analytics uses the separately verified Gold publication. Their totals must not be blended.

Demonstration dataset; amounts shown in USD. Flags and P1 priority are screening measures, not confirmed fraud findings or calibrated probabilities. The ML training workflow does not score the deployed agent queue. No external action or implemented approval workflow is demonstrated.
